cvars.name: rc_retail_gameplay
cvars.desc_en: Brings back the retail behavior of every balance fix at once: monster damage and health, AI, ladder climbs and collision.

cvars.name: rc_infinite_stamina
cvars.desc_en: Stamina never runs out. The stamina bar still shows.

cvars.name: rc_hlmovement
cvars.desc_en: Half-Life 1 physics as in the WON version: run speed 320, no sprint, dodge or stamina cost for jumps, no movement camera punches or fall over, and the ladders are climbed as Half-Life ladders. Also turns the bunny hop cap off and ducktap and autojump on. A separate speedrun category.

cvars.name: rc_bhopcap
cvars.desc_en: On as in retail. Off removes the cap, which a separate speedrun category uses.

cvars.name: rc_ducktap
cvars.desc_en: Brings back the Half-Life ducktap that Cry of Fear removed.

cvars.name: rc_autojump
cvars.desc_en: Holding jump jumps again on landing.

cvars.name: rc_ducktap_priority
cvars.desc_en: While the ducktap key is held, autojump pauses.

cvars.name: rc_jump_priority
cvars.desc_en: While jump is held, the ducktap key pauses.

cvars.name: rc_speedometer
cvars.desc_en: Shows your horizontal speed on screen.

cvars.name: rc_speedometer_jump
cvars.desc_en: Shows the speed at your last jump under the speedometer.

cvars.name: rc_speedometer_3d
cvars.desc_en: The speedometer counts vertical speed too.

cvars.name: rc_rawinput
cvars.desc_en: Reads the mouse directly, without Windows acceleration. Off gives the retail mouse.

cvars.name: rc_modelarrays
cvars.desc_en: Sends each model strip to the driver in one call. The picture is the same; off is the retail path, for comparison.

cvars.name: rc_prof
cvars.desc_en: 1 shows how long each part of the frame takes, 2 adds GPU times.

cvars.name: rc_crosshair
cvars.desc_en: Off hides the red crosshair and keeps the ammo display.

cvars.name: rc_viewmodel_fov
cvars.desc_en: Draws the weapon model with its own field of view, as BunnymodXT's bxt_viewmodel_fov. 0 keeps the view's.

cvars.name: rc_viewmodel_ofs_forward
cvars.desc_en: Moves the weapon model forward (or back, below 0), in units. Iron sights ignore it.

cvars.name: rc_viewmodel_ofs_right
cvars.desc_en: Moves the weapon model right (or left, below 0), in units. Iron sights ignore it.

cvars.name: rc_viewmodel_ofs_up
cvars.desc_en: Moves the weapon model up (or down, below 0), in units. Iron sights ignore it.
